![This Is What Happens When You Mix Tums And Alcohol](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11240720-1853-0139-0000-72b21dad17ef:4)
` [Highlight start] There is no direct chemical interaction between Tums (calcium carbonate) and alcohol [Highlight end] ` , so taking Tums for heartburn or indigestion associated with drinking is generally safe. However, Tums does not prevent alcohol-induced heartburn, and alcohol can still trigger reflux or irritate your stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX3k0yAOlGdFEj-7Ac1Vt-6cbiRTojQRoHaRmXggDg1BXmDSUt-Rm3Qcdw66sOgvACti7OcMWJxXs7KU0sjk9ocDIaN6am9HwmOMM1R0fn2kInXwSdNzQbPK1tF2Lrs1FXeeg_qhVOb3I)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXz8yDfeSyjA4C4MfgxCBHmnAsC_oPeC0ceyUgvmEXNvFzVPyAiMxyQg6vU2T8Nc_Cry0ZM12VAX83-f3UCl6iX4dxWwfDeMY9TTRfyfQo_hmsC8gRhyGhvduiJQY58inuyiEhTObh3RQAXRbBUEHMzfEckVLQ4_4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX403d_oe36ycBGpsl-B0RjTUQmVsnkWPnpQ9UEOF_3js8_nC98z73y-o5Jo69-dqhKu0-zRyCJ5iNOIyxNzO-DR1EV5oSt4MgqQTQ4HNeSIImQamDVvIv6rKSvZR2slbgt0p5QTHKxRMMvGt1Vw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1xlPQBF6CIqYvcB1OJPb_NAL3fdJMEDaJawC4psU-L0vEHYeDP81uxjp5b5kupmg3TDLxVj7iQcS_-_lACt8Sd3KdeEpL8u4TdAny6Fc0_Ezf05zOFB1-hXaarri-6cySYngYjzqZ-Yl0SRKXMqD-91CjRop6V53mzNcStaD0qi9bkWef5Zzv3X2vQF_-w)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVQHEIkXX90XWDaR0xdaOCNGdcg_ga_Gy-TPnAmFdcOTFFjWQOysKhvxuxkbDiFY7b1QOQJjrWG516Rg3-HvUGi_ofIbjzUA1EAgDIJe8I3DzbYxX6XE)

### How They Interact

- **No direct drug interaction:** Alcohol does not react directly with calcium carbonate, the active ingredient in Tums.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX3k0yAOlGdFEj-7Ac1Vt-6cbiRTojQRoHaRmXggDg1BXmDSUt-Rm3Qcdw66sOgvACti7OcMWJxXs7KU0sjk9ocDIaN6am9HwmOMM1R0fn2kInXwSdNzQbPK1tF2Lrs1FXeeg_qhVOb3I)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXz8yDfeSyjA4C4MfgxCBHmnAsC_oPeC0ceyUgvmEXNvFzVPyAiMxyQg6vU2T8Nc_Cry0ZM12VAX83-f3UCl6iX4dxWwfDeMY9TTRfyfQo_hmsC8gRhyGhvduiJQY58inuyiEhTObh3RQAXRbBUEHMzfEckVLQ4_4)
- **Limited effectiveness during drinking:** Alcohol relaxes the lower esophageal sphincter (LES) and increases stomach acid, which can overpower Tums or undo its acid-neutralizing effect if you keep drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX3k0yAOlGdFEj-7Ac1Vt-6cbiRTojQRoHaRmXggDg1BXmDSUt-Rm3Qcdw66sOgvACti7OcMWJxXs7KU0sjk9ocDIaN6am9HwmOMM1R0fn2kInXwSdNzQbPK1tF2Lrs1FXeeg_qhVOb3I)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXz8yDfeSyjA4C4MfgxCBHmnAsC_oPeC0ceyUgvmEXNvFzVPyAiMxyQg6vU2T8Nc_Cry0ZM12VAX83-f3UCl6iX4dxWwfDeMY9TTRfyfQo_hmsC8gRhyGhvduiJQY58inuyiEhTObh3RQAXRbBUEHMzfEckVLQ4_4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1xlPQBF6CIqYvcB1OJPb_NAL3fdJMEDaJawC4psU-L0vEHYeDP81uxjp5b5kupmg3TDLxVj7iQcS_-_lACt8Sd3KdeEpL8u4TdAny6Fc0_Ezf05zOFB1-hXaarri-6cySYngYjzqZ-Yl0SRKXMqD-91CjRop6V53mzNcStaD0qi9bkWef5Zzv3X2vQF_-w)
- **Not a preventive:** Tums is meant to treat existing heartburn symptoms rather than prevent reflux before or while drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVQHEIkXX90XWDaR0xdaOCNGdcg_ga_Gy-TPnAmFdcOTFFjWQOysKhvxuxkbDiFY7b1QOQJjrWG516Rg3-HvUGi_ofIbjzUA1EAgDIJe8I3DzbYxX6XE)
- **Forum consensus:** Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF1zckZ4NQkfe5FZAClZ5O3ieUJVKCgx0HS4aYCPH7YvTIpm3nrfbqMn0E58Nm3llFzoJRGc43M2TAfdKpHthAcfpOkQIU0nXIVZwL4ZKJ5fhQz0ied1WkkZCxro29rDjbQYb33oUXsX1NIKu1HsYsUXfIGswzaznBYZZlMtd61ntGeA-vjsThD4Ipi9-J1HdSW3SO5g) agree that taking antacids like Tums can help ease bloating or stomach discomfort after drinking beer.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmAEBxCJF1zckZ4NQkfe5FZAClZ5O3ieUJVKCgx0HS4aYCPH7YvTIpm3nrfbqMn0E58Nm3llFzoJRGc43M2TAfdKpHthAcfpOkQIU0nXIVZwL4ZKJ5fhQz0ied1WkkZCxro29rDjbQYb33oUXsX1NIKu1HsYsUXfIGswzaznBYZZlMtd61ntGeA-vjsThD4Ipi9-J1HdSW3SO5g)

### Practical Tips

- **Use after symptoms start:** Take Tums when heartburn, sour stomach, or mild reflux occurs—such as later in the evening or the next morning—rather than taking it ahead of time to block symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX403d_oe36ycBGpsl-B0RjTUQmVsnkWPnpQ9UEOF_3js8_nC98z73y-o5Jo69-dqhKu0-zRyCJ5iNOIyxNzO-DR1EV5oSt4MgqQTQ4HNeSIImQamDVvIv6rKSvZR2slbgt0p5QTHKxRMMvGt1Vw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVQHEIkXX90XWDaR0xdaOCNGdcg_ga_Gy-TPnAmFdcOTFFjWQOysKhvxuxkbDiFY7b1QOQJjrWG516Rg3-HvUGi_ofIbjzUA1EAgDIJe8I3DzbYxX6XE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1xlPQBF6CIqYvcB1OJPb_NAL3fdJMEDaJawC4psU-L0vEHYeDP81uxjp5b5kupmg3TDLxVj7iQcS_-_lACt8Sd3KdeEpL8u4TdAny6Fc0_Ezf05zOFB1-hXaarri-6cySYngYjzqZ-Yl0SRKXMqD-91CjRop6V53mzNcStaD0qi9bkWef5Zzv3X2vQF_-w)
- **Watch the dosage:** Stick to label directions and avoid taking excessive amounts, as high calcium carbonate intake can cause stomach upset or hypercalcemia.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXz8yDfeSyjA4C4MfgxCBHmnAsC_oPeC0ceyUgvmEXNvFzVPyAiMxyQg6vU2T8Nc_Cry0ZM12VAX83-f3UCl6iX4dxWwfDeMY9TTRfyfQo_hmsC8gRhyGhvduiJQY58inuyiEhTObh3RQAXRbBUEHMzfEckVLQ4_4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX403d_oe36ycBGpsl-B0RjTUQmVsnkWPnpQ9UEOF_3js8_nC98z73y-o5Jo69-dqhKu0-zRyCJ5iNOIyxNzO-DR1EV5oSt4MgqQTQ4HNeSIImQamDVvIv6rKSvZR2slbgt0p5QTHKxRMMvGt1Vw)
- **Pair with water:** Drink water to stay hydrated and help soothe your stomach. Avoid adding NSAIDs like ibuprofen if your stomach is already irritated.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1xlPQBF6CIqYvcB1OJPb_NAL3fdJMEDaJawC4psU-L0vEHYeDP81uxjp5b5kupmg3TDLxVj7iQcS_-_lACt8Sd3KdeEpL8u4TdAny6Fc0_Ezf05zOFB1-hXaarri-6cySYngYjzqZ-Yl0SRKXMqD-91CjRop6V53mzNcStaD0qi9bkWef5Zzv3X2vQF_-w)
- **Check other medications:** Tums can interfere with the absorption of certain other medications, so space doses apart as recommended on [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX3k0yAOlGdFEj-7Ac1Vt-6cbiRTojQRoHaRmXggDg1BXmDSUt-Rm3Qcdw66sOgvACti7OcMWJxXs7KU0sjk9ocDIaN6am9HwmOMM1R0fn2kInXwSdNzQbPK1tF2Lrs1FXeeg_qhVOb3I).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX3k0yAOlGdFEj-7Ac1Vt-6cbiRTojQRoHaRmXggDg1BXmDSUt-Rm3Qcdw66sOgvACti7OcMWJxXs7KU0sjk9ocDIaN6am9HwmOMM1R0fn2kInXwSdNzQbPK1tF2Lrs1FXeeg_qhVOb3I)

Are you asking because you are **dealing with heartburn right now**, **planning to drink later** , or **looking for alternatives** that last longer? Sharing if you take **other daily medications** can also help me give more tailored info.
